field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: PA economic nexus threshold: $500,000 gross receipts (higher than typical $100K)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: PA has no transaction count threshold (receipts only)

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: PA uses 100% single-sales factor apportionment (PA Code § 7401(3)2.(a)(17))

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: PA Corporate Net Income Tax rate: 8.99% (PA Code § 7401(3)1.(a), 2025)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: PA additions: federal interest income, IRC 199A deduction addback, state/local taxes deducted

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: PA subtractions: state/municipal bond interest, dividends (qualified), PA NOL

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: PA tax credits: R&D, Film, Manufacturing, Job Creation, Keystone Opportunity Zone
